context: A police officer briefs a uni reporter about a hacking case
purpose: Teach: 河野/反戦/飲酒/尋問/ハッカー/出世/失点/致命

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 河野容疑者、ハッカー集団の中核と判明しました。
lines.en: Suspect Kono has been identified as a core member of the hacker group.
lines.style: Professional, measured delivery. Slight pause after the name to let it land. Even tone, factual weight without drama. Steady eye contact — this is routine briefing, but matters.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 当日、飲酒運転で別件逮捕されたんですよね。
lines.en: So he was arrested on the DUI charge that same day, wasn't he?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, slightly tentative — reaching to understand the timeline. Leans forward slightly. Tone is earnest, not skeptical. A question that wants the answer to make sense.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。長時間の尋問で、出世欲が動機の核と判明。
lines.en: That's correct. During the extended questioning, his ambition for promotion emerged as the core motivation.
lines.style: Calm, procedural tone. Measured pacing — each clause deliberate. Not rushing. The voice of someone used to translating messy hours into clear facts. Slight formality that respects what was learned.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 反戦系のメッセージで偽装した手口、致命的でしたね。
lines.en: The way he disguised it with anti-war messaging was what ultimately exposed him, wasn't it?
lines.style: Thoughtful, probing intonation. Not accusatory — analytical. Slight upward lift on the final phrase, inviting agreement. Pace is steady, almost conversational despite the weight of the statement.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 被害企業、失点を最小化すべく、迅速に動きました。
lines.en: The affected companies acted quickly to minimize their losses.
lines.style: Calm, concluding delivery. Slight drop in pace compared to earlier lines — settling into summary. No judgment, just observation. The closing note of someone wrapping a briefing with competence.
